shipLog.text: ◆ The wheat is growing predictably. This is its best and worst quality.
◆ ARIA is thrilled the crop has been planted! She has already named all the seedlings! The ship computer has asked her to stop!
Arrived at Second Choice Prime! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
Departure Protocol: we chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Love that for us!
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ Planetary approach! ARIA estimates the surface is 70% wonderful! She did not measure the other 30%!
Arrived at Asteroid Field 2! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
Traffic Control Would Like A Word: we chose “Slow down and wave at the camera”. Love that for us!
You drop to corridor speed and give the traffic buoy a slow… +2 MORALE, 2 DAYS. A win, statistically!
▶ TRADER SHIP ON APPROACH
Arrived at Route Decision! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
Show of Hands: we chose “Let the crew vote”. Love that for us!
Port wins by one vote after a recount, a challenge, and a second… +3 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ Still thinking about launch day! Every system was perfect and the paperwork was barely any paperwork at all!
The Wheat hit VEGETATIVE! 25% grown, health 100. Thriving!
Arrived at Candidate Alpha! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (2/3). The colony office will want this.
Vessel Approaching: we chose “Fight — bring weapons online”. Love that for us!
Vessel Approaching: we WON! −25 HULL, +1 MORALE, 2 DAYS. Teamwork!
◆ Planetary approach! ARIA estimates the surface is 70% wonderful! She did not measure the other 30%!
Arrived at That One With The Rings! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (3/3). The colony office will want this.
◆ The ship computer has started calling the wheat "humanity's oldest crewmate." Ten thousand years of harvests, and it sounds almost fond.
Passenger Manifest: One (1)…: we chose “Confine them until the next stop”. Love that for us!
You assign them quarters and a schedule that keeps them out of the… −4 MORALE, 1 DAY. Still a win!
◆ ARIA has organized the star chart by prettiness! The navigation copy is untouched! She's not a MONSTER!
Arrived at The Refueling Opportunity! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ MARV files a note on what looking back at everything from far away does to crews. The effect has a name.
The Middle: we chose “Mark it — small ceremony, real juice”. Love that for us!
The crew assembles at the viewport for the equator crossing. +5 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!
−1 FOOD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Station Inbound: we chose “LEAVE STATION”. Love that for us!
Nothing aboard changed. A win, statistically!
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ Station arrival! ARIA has read every review of this station! She has chosen to believe the five-star one! It was written by the station!
The Wheat hit FLOWERING! 55% grown, health 100. Thriving!

identity.name: Pip Andrade
identity.story: They are nineteen and lost the colony lottery four times. The fifth time, they stopped entering and started planning. They have a duffel bag, a forged cargo manifest that fooled nobody — the crew has known for a week and said nothing — and the specific unbeatable stubbornness of someone who has decided their life is happening whether invited or not.
identity.line: I'll work. I'll eat less than I work. You won't regret it — or you will, but not about me.
identity.join_note: No training, endless effort. The crew adopted them before you decided anything, which you will discover shortly.
